header.name: Verdant Bot 0.9.0 • Bedrock 1.21.114 • Advanced Speedrun
header.description: 0.9.0 ADVANCED: Full speedrun bot with deep mining (branch + vein clustering, Y-level optimized, obstruction clearing), builder (bridging/pillaring/scaffolding), advanced combat (kite/rush/retreat tactics, group handling, crits, strafing), looting (scored chest evaluation, village detection, home avoidance), parkour (1-gap, 2-gap sprint jumps, jump-up, big drops), boat travel improved, resource manager (auto organize, opportunistic gathering), speedrun director (wood->stone->iron->diamond->portal). Fixes: mining below now clears obstructions instead of blacklisting, tree mining scaffolds to high logs, mine mode explores instead of idling after no target, bridging places real blocks with support checks, crops added to mineable. New modules: builder.js, combat.js, looting.js, parkour.js, deepminer.js, resource.js, speedrun.js, blocks.js, combat core, loot core, mining-strategy core. Commands: !bot speedrun, !bot deepmine, config speedrun. Fast dev cycle: modular pure core + runtime separation, JSDoc, no circular deps.
